subject: Brightwell: 3-year commitment — price lock + renewal protection?
messages:
From: Sandra McKay <sandra@brightwell.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Pricing structure for 3-year commitment - Brightwell

Camila — thanks for the call earlier. Procurement is targeting a board review the week of Sep 7, so we need final commercial terms by end of next week if possible. A few asks from our CFO/procurement team: 

- Can Redwood commit to a price lock for the full 36 months (no uplifts > 3%/yr)?
- If there is an uplifts cap, can we have an explicit renewal-protection clause so the effective unit price at renewal cannot exceed the prior term + agreed cap?
- We need a commitment that pricing changes will not occur mid-term unless materially required (e.g., regulatory).

Attached is Brightwell_RFP_v3.pdf and a short procurement note. If you can send a proposed term sheet with those items called out, we can route internally.

Thanks — Sandra
Sandra McKay
VP, Strategic Sourcing
Brightwell Health
procurement@brightwell.com
+1 (617) 555-0142

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T17:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pricing structure for 3-year commitment - Brightwell (needs exec sign)

Team — forwarding Brightwell's ask. TL;DR: customer wants a hard 36-month price lock (no mid-term increases) and an explicit renewal-protection clause limiting renewal increases to <= 3%/yr. Board review week of Sep 7; procurement requests final terms by end of next week.

Attached I've included a draft term sheet (Proposed_Terms_Brightwell_3yr.pdf) with two paths:
1) Standard 3-yr reserved commit with 3% uplift cap and renewal protection (preferred by AE).
2) Deeper discount if we add a 6-month minimum ramp guarantee and 24-month minimum notice for re-quantization.

Request: can Deal Desk/Exec provide sign-off or escalation? Jordan, can you prepare a one-page ask for aditya with the financial impact? I put Lauren on for legal redline coordination.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T20:15:00Z
Subject: Brightwell (DL-98047) — exec approval request: 3yr price lock + renewal-protection

Aditya — need an expedited exec decision for Brightwell (re: camila's thread). Summary below; full P&L impact attached and a redline (redline_terms_v1.docx) with proposed language for the renewal-protection clause.

Summary:
- ACV at proposed price: $5.2M first year, $5.2M/year run-rate across the 3-year term (customer requests fixed unit price).
- Request: 36-month price lock; uplift cap <= 3%/yr; renewal-protection clause preventing effective unit price at renewal to exceed prior term + agreed cap.
- Tradeoffs: we can offer a 7% one-time upfront commitment credit (applied to year 1) in exchange for guaranteed min usage ramp (70% of committed capacity by month 9). Alternatively, we keep standard 5% multi-year discount and ask for an SLA premium.
- Legal asks: explicit language that any mid-term price adjustments require mutual written consent and are limited to force majeure / regulatory changes.

Attachments: financial_impact_Brightwell_DL-98047.pdf, redline_terms_v1.docx (see key clause on page 2). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/98047

Requested decision: approve the 3% uplift cap + renewal protection with the 7% up-front credit trade for usage ramp clause, or instruct alternate guardrails. This will close the deal this quarter but reduces short-term realized revenue by approx $450k in year 1 vs our baseline.

If you want a quick sync, I can be on call tonight.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T01:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Brightwell (DL-98047) — quick exec sign needed

Aditya — forwarding Jordan's summary. Quick context from me: Brightwell is a strategic target in the northeast health vertical; likely 3–4 additional similar logos in our pipeline if we lock this in with competitive protections. Suggest we approve but with two non-negotiables:

1) Renewal protection limited to a fixed formula: prior term effective unit price + max 3%/year; no compound re-pricing mid-term.
2) Include a usage ramp milestone tied to the 7% upfront credit; failure to meet ramp allows us to recapture credit pro rata.

If approved, legal (Lauren) will finalize the redline and we can present a term sheet to Sandra tomorrow.

> Team — forwarding Brightwell's ask. TL;DR: customer wants a hard 36-month price lock...

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T02:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Brightwell (DL-98047) — exec approval request: 3yr price lock + renewal-protection

All — after reviewing the deck and financial impact, approve the following, effective immediately: 

- Approve 36-month price lock with an uplift cap of 3% per year (non-compounding for contract lifetime).
- Approve explicit renewal-protection clause: at renewal, effective unit price <= prior term effective unit price + 3% * number of years since last effective price (i.e., simple cap).
- Approve 7% upfront commitment credit contingent on a usage ramp milestone (70% committed capacity by month 9). Credit recapture: pro rata if milestone not met.

Conditions: legal to insert recapture mechanics and an explicit carveout allowing mid-term pricing adjustments only for regulatory/policy changes; finance to sign off on final revenue recognition treatment. Please run final redline through me if there are material changes.

Jordan/Camila: proceed to finalize term sheet with Brightwell and copy me on the send. Lauren — please coordinate the redline and loop in compliance if needed.

Good work — this is strategic. Let's close it cleanly.

— Aditya Rao
